description: Source code for webpa_notification module handling notification configuration, MAC address processing, and reading notification parameters from a JSON config file.

methods.name: setNotifyConfigurationFile
methods.description: Sets the path to the notification configuration file.

methods.name: getNotifySource
methods.description: Retrieves the notification source MAC address, converting it to lowercase and formatting it.
